techniques.name: Prefix tuning
techniques.goal: Adapt a frozen local model with tiny task-specific learned prefixes
techniques.mechanism: Optimize continuous virtual-token activations prepended to every layer/attention context while keeping model weights frozen.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential future substitute for long repeated textual task instructions.
use_when: Many repeated calls where prompt tokens are costly
risks: soft prompt is opaque to humans

techniques.name: Soft prompt tuning
techniques.goal: Learn compact continuous task instructions
techniques.mechanism: Optimize a small sequence of embedding vectors while freezing the base model.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Could be benchmarked against text prompts only after local model serving exists.
use_when: Large local model with stable task

techniques.name: IA3
techniques.goal: Fine-tune with extremely small per-task parameter set
techniques.mechanism: Learn vectors that scale key/value/feed-forward activations instead of weight matrices.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful alternative in future PEFT bake-off.

techniques.name: Compacter adapters
techniques.goal: Compress adapter parameters while retaining task adaptation
techniques.mechanism: Use structured low-rank hypercomplex adapter matrices with shared slow and task-specific fast parameters.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only revisit if adapter storage becomes a real bottleneck.
use_when: Large number of task-specific local adapters
avoid_when: Small number of adapters where LoRA simplicity wins

techniques.name: DoRA
techniques.goal: Close LoRA/full-finetune quality gap without inference overhead
techniques.mechanism: Decompose pretrained weights into magnitude and direction; update directional component with low-rank adapter and magnitude separately.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Future local-model challenger, not default.
use_when: Local model specialization where LoRA underperforms

techniques.name: VeRA
techniques.goal: Minimize per-task adapter storage
techniques.mechanism: Share frozen random low-rank matrices across layers and learn only scaling vectors.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential personalization research only with strict privacy boundaries.
avoid_when: Maximum quality more important than storage

techniques.name: NEFTune embedding-noise regularization
techniques.goal: Improve instruction-tuning generalization with minimal code change
techniques.mechanism: Inject scaled random noise into token embeddings during fine-tuning only.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Simple experiment candidate if Agent OS trains a local instruction model.
risks: large reported gains may be eval-specific

techniques.name: Model soups / weight averaging
techniques.goal: Improve robustness/accuracy without ensemble inference cost
techniques.mechanism: Average compatible fine-tuned checkpoints lying in similar low-loss basin.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Keep every source checkpoint/eval for rollback.
use_when: Multiple compatible fine-tunes of same base/task
risks: Averaging incompatible solutions can collapse performance

techniques.name: Task arithmetic
techniques.goal: Compose or negate learned capabilities via weight deltas
techniques.mechanism: Represent fine-tuning as vector from base weights and add/subtract scaled task vectors.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential future experiment for merging Agent OS specialist adapters.
use_when: Homologous local models with modular adaptations
techniques.cost_profile: no retraining after task vectors exist

techniques.name: TIES merging
techniques.goal: Reduce destructive interference among merged task vectors
techniques.mechanism: Trim small deltas, elect common sign and merge only sign-consistent values.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Better merge baseline than naive averaging when task deltas conflict.
risks: Can still create unexpected cross-task interactions

techniques.name: DARE delta sparsification before merging
techniques.goal: Reduce task-delta interference and enable capability composition
techniques.mechanism: Randomly drop much of fine-tuning delta then rescale retained deltas before merging.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only benchmark after conventional/TIES merge baselines.
risks: capability damage hidden by aggregate metrics

techniques.name: SparseGPT one-shot pruning
techniques.goal: Reduce model weight memory with limited retraining burden
techniques.mechanism: Use approximate second-order reconstruction to choose/adjust sparse weights in one shot.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Benchmark real wall-clock hardware, not sparsity percentage.
use_when: Self-hosted model where sparse hardware/kernel can exploit it
techniques.cost_profile: offline pruning; lower potential serving cost

techniques.name: Wanda activation-aware pruning
techniques.goal: Obtain simple no-retraining sparsity baseline
techniques.mechanism: Prune low importance weights using magnitude × input activation norm per output.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful pruning baseline because implementation is simple.
risks: Hard tasks may degrade before easy benchmarks

techniques.name: Structured layer pruning / ShortGPT
techniques.goal: Reduce depth and dense compute with hardware-friendly compression
techniques.mechanism: Estimate block influence and remove low-impact transformer layers entirely.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Requires long-tail regression corpus, not perplexity alone.
avoid_when: Broad capabilities depend on apparently low-average-impact layers

techniques.name: Structured width/depth pruning + distillation
techniques.goal: Create smaller dense models from a strong parent
techniques.mechanism: Search structured width/depth reductions and retrain student primarily with teacher distillation.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential route to cheap local classifier/extractor models.
use_when: Building a family of local models

techniques.name: Mixture-of-Depths dynamic token compute
techniques.goal: Spend transformer-layer compute on only selected token positions
techniques.mechanism: Learn top-k routing per layer so a fixed fraction of tokens run attention/MLP while others bypass.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Conceptually reinforces Agent OS adaptive compute: spend work where value is highest.
use_when: Training future local architecture under strict FLOP budget

techniques.name: Heavy-hitter KV eviction (H2O)
techniques.goal: Reduce KV memory while retaining influential history
techniques.mechanism: Keep recent tokens plus historically high-attention heavy hitters; evict low-value KV entries.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: External Agent OS memory remains source of truth; compressed KV is ephemeral.
use_when: Self-hosted long-dialogue model under KV-memory pressure
avoid_when: Tasks requiring later recovery of seemingly low-attention details
risks: Evicted detail cannot be recovered from cache

techniques.name: Scissorhands persistent-importance KV compression
techniques.goal: Bound KV cache memory during long decoding
techniques.mechanism: Probabilistically retain tokens that have been important in prior attention under persistence-of-importance hypothesis.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Compare against H2O/sliding/quantized KV before adoption.

techniques.name: Attention-sink streaming window
techniques.goal: Support unbounded streaming with fixed-size KV cache
techniques.mechanism: Retain a small initial attention-sink prefix plus rolling recent-token window.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Strong fit only if Agent OS external memory retrieves old facts explicitly.
use_when: Local continuous transcript/chat stream where old details are externalized elsewhere
avoid_when: Need random access to arbitrary old in-context detail
risks: Looks like infinite context but old token content is absent

techniques.name: LongLoRA
techniques.goal: Fine-tune local models for longer context more cheaply
techniques.mechanism: Use shift-short sparse attention during fine-tuning plus LoRA while restoring dense attention at inference.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only after proving retrieval/compaction is insufficient.
use_when: Local model needs longer native context
avoid_when: Application retrieval solves problem more cheaply
risks: Nominal window can exceed real reasoning capacity

techniques.name: Ring Attention
techniques.goal: Scale exact attention context across multiple devices
techniques.mechanism: Shard sequence blocks across devices in a ring and overlap KV communication with blockwise compute.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Track if future Agent OS runs local multimillion-token analyses.

techniques.name: Landmark Attention
techniques.goal: Give model learned random access over massive context with fewer attended tokens
techniques.mechanism: Insert landmark tokens summarizing blocks and train attention to select relevant blocks via landmarks.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS should prefer external retrieval for provenance until a clear advantage appears.
risks: Learned internal retrieval is harder to inspect than external retrieval

techniques.name: Execution-based web-agent evaluation
techniques.goal: Measure whether an agent actually changed web state correctly
techniques.mechanism: Run reproducible web tasks and inspect database/UI end state rather than judge only textual trajectory.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS browser skills should have task fixtures and state validators.
avoid_when: Pure read-only factual research may need answer grading too
risks: Benchmark environment may not capture live-web drift

techniques.name: Execution-based desktop/computer-use evaluation
techniques.goal: Test full cross-application outcomes on real OS state
techniques.mechanism: Initialize reproducible desktop VM, run agent, score resulting files/app states with scripts.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Build a tiny personalized OSWorld-like suite from recurring desktop workflows.

techniques.name: Realistic time-consuming assistant benchmark
techniques.goal: Evaluate assistant tasks requiring broad search, persistence and precise answer assembly
techniques.mechanism: Use realistic multi-source tasks with automatic scoring and explicit precision/completeness metrics.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Create private Agent OS assistant suite from actual recurring tasks.

techniques.name: Multi-environment agent benchmark
techniques.goal: Detect general agent weaknesses across environments rather than one narrow benchmark
techniques.mechanism: Run same model/scaffold across heterogeneous interactive tasks and classify failure mechanisms.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use external benchmarks as diagnostic priors, not route decision truth.
risks: Breadth can dilute relevance to user's actual tasks

techniques.name: LLM-to-classical-planner translation (LLM+P)
techniques.goal: Get feasible/optimal plans where state/actions are formalizable
techniques.mechanism: Model translates natural-language task/state into PDDL; deterministic classical planner searches; model translates plan back.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: High-value adjacent field: use solvers for constraints rather than asking LLM to mentally optimize.
avoid_when: Open-ended environment lacking stable action/state model
risks: Wrong formalization yields valid solution to wrong problem

techniques.name: Programmatic action-space prompting
techniques.goal: Reduce hallucinated impossible actions
techniques.mechanism: Represent available actions, objects, preconditions and examples in executable/program-like prompt contract.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Tool schemas are Agent OS's natural implementation of this principle.
avoid_when: Huge rapidly changing action space better exposed as tools

techniques.name: Closed-loop environment feedback
techniques.goal: Revise plans based on actual outcome rather than assumed effects
techniques.mechanism: After action, feed structured success/failure/state/perception back to planner; replan only when observed state diverges.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every action should have observable postcondition where practical.

techniques.name: Structured skill/action library for open-world agents
techniques.goal: Convert recurring successful behavior into reusable bounded capabilities
techniques.mechanism: Represent named skills/actions with preconditions, parameters and executable implementation, and let planner compose them.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Existing Skill Miner should add usage/deprecation/overlap evidence.
